verdicts.title: On Small-depth Frege Proofs for PHP
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study Frege proofs for the one-to-one graph Pigeon Hole Principle defined on the $n\times n$ grid where $n$ is odd. We are interested in the case where each formula in the proof is a depth $d$ formula in the basis given by $\land$, $\lor$, and $\neg$. We prove that in this situation the proof needs to be of size exponential in $n^{Ω(1/d)}$. verdicts.title: Tradeoffs for small-depth Frege proofs
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:

verdicts.title: The canonical pairs of bounded depth Frege systems
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The canonical pair of a proof system $P$ is the pair of disjoint NP sets where one set is the set of all satisfiable CNF formulas and the other is the set of CNF formulas that have $P$-proofs bounded by some polynomial.
